name: LTX-2.5 HQ (q4)
about: LTX-2.5 HQ 22B audio+video, int4: the open dev model with real CFG (res_2s sampler, 15 steps) at half size, then the distilled LoRA refines at full size — the closest local thing to Lightricks' hosted LTX-2.5 Pro (API only). More detail and closer prompt following than the distilled model, but about 6× slower (q8, 512×320, 49 frames: 5.7 min against 1 min distilled, peak ~30 GB); fits 32 GB at small sizes. Shares the folder of LTX-2.5 (q4): adds the dev transformer and the distilled LoRA
